SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, count(DISTINCT channel_code) ch, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT f.sale_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(*) lines, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT s.store_key) sk
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.sales_line_id, f.product_key
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT sku, sum(quantity) units_all, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE quantity END) units_nostaff, count(DISTINCT product_key) versions, count(*) lines
FROM s GROUP BY sku ORDER BY units_all DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT product_key) pk, count(DISTINCT sku) sk FROM dim_product
UNION ALL
SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT sku), count(DISTINCT product_name) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sku, product_name FROM dim_product)

SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.listed_from, p.delisted_on, max(f.quantity) maxq, min(f.quantity) minq, sum(f.quantity) units,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f2 USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=f2.product_key WHERE p2.sku=p.sku AND f2.store_key IN (3,4) AND f2.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') returned_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
WHERE f.store_key IN (3,4) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units DESC
